source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject writes to installed `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` paths.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation prevents writes to the installed BMAD/GDS path families.
source_gap_claims.subject: Installed BMAD/GDS path boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject writes to Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and user-sandbox paths.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation covers these preserved service and sandbox write boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Phase and sandbox boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require defect-revealing tests before production behavior changes, including truthful characterization and a distinct fault witness for existing passing brownfield behavior.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation requires prior real defect-revealing testing or rejects fabricated/post-hoc failure evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Production-change test discipline

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require the detached positive Probe to pass and the detached negative Probe to fail for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed Probe obligations require detached execution and failure-family handling but do not represent the positive-pass and declared-defect/diagnostic oracle independently.
source_gap_claims.subject: Probe oracle outcomes

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require Stable to have verifiable provenance for existing supported behavior and require Candidate to contain the real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: Immutable two-subject execution does not represent Stable provenance eligibility or the Candidate real-change requirement.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable and Candidate eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require the six Matrix Cases to implement the named semantic distinctions: valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap.
source_gap_claims.reason: A requirement for six materially distinct cases does not require these six specified semantic case types.
source_gap_claims.subject: Closed Matrix Case semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Permit expected-difference only when frozen for that case and all execution and evidence gates pass, and prohibit it from approving a regression.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed terminal-category obligation names expected-difference but does not impose its frozen-case, gating, and no-regression conditions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Expected-difference Matrix result

source_gap_claims.behavior: Bind each Consumer's actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed Consumer obligations require calls and reconciliation but do not require this complete per-Consumer invocation binding.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer invocation binding

source_gap_claims.behavior: For disable, invoke the Prior Route and reproduce Prior Route identity plus the Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: The disable obligation only requires a real disable call; restoration is represented only for the aggregate sequence and does not independently require the disable postcondition for every applicable fixture.
source_gap_claims.subject: Disable transition postcondition

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require each behavioral obligation to have its own observable fault witness and each non-behavioral obligation to have a deterministic violation witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: Exact Cover and required-witness coverage do not independently impose the witness type and per-obligation fault-witness rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Independent obligation witnesses

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation, evaluation-set admission, quality-baseline creation, promotion, Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canaries, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, and cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations prohibit only another TC-D1 requirement tree and the v1/current-pointer redesign; they do not represent these independent scope exclusions.
source_gap_claims.subject: TC-D1 scope exclusions
